name: Manoel Sousa
event: UFC Fight Night: Procházka vs. Stirling
summary: A Brazilian lightweight knockout artist nicknamed 'Manumito' (15-1; 2-0 UFC; age 29). He won his contract with a R3 KO on the 2025 Contender Series, knocked out Bolaji Oki in R3 of his March debut for a performance bonus, and outpointed LFA champion Richie Miranda (29-28 x3) in August. His reported Doha opponent Magomed Zaynukov said he never signed and is out for the year after surgery; as of November 10 no replacement has been named and the bout is not on the UFC.com card.

how_they_fight.Striking: Heavy hitter: about 0.8 knockdowns per 15 and nine KO/TKO wins. He finished Oki with a straight right at 4:12 of R3 after earlier knockdowns (Yahoo/MMA Junkie). Against Miranda he chopped the lead leg with kicks, dropped him with a body shot in R2, and landed heavy hooks (Cageside). Tends to overswing: an overcommitted punch gave Miranda his R1 takedown.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Mostly defensive. Three submission wins, all on the regional scene. He rarely shoots (0.5 per 15) and his control share is low.
how_they_fight.Defense: Takedown defense is the question. Cristian Perez held him down for about 7:46 in their Contender Series fight and Oki about 3:23, per our data, and Miranda took his back in R1. He fought off submissions, got up, and stuffed the rest of Miranda's shots (Cageside). Never stopped: his only loss was a 2024 Bellator decision to Archie Colgan.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: A late finisher at UFC level. His 12 stoppage wins came 5 in R1, 5 in R2 and 2 in R3, but both R3 KOs are his two most recent finishes (Perez, Oki), and he won R2-R3 against Miranda after losing R1. He gets stronger as fights go on rather than fading.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Adjusts in-fight: switched to leg kicks after losing R1 to Miranda (Cageside). Can get loose and wild with power shots early.

patterns: Power punching and hard leg kicks
Finishes late: last two finishes were R3 knockouts
Gets taken down early, survives and comes back
Never stopped; one career loss, on points
concerns: No confirmed opponent eleven days out
Gives up takedowns and control time when he overcommits
keys_to_beat: Wrestle early and stay on top; he has been held down in all three of his UFC/DWCS fights
Win R1-R2 clearly and avoid trading late
Make him miss and counter the overswing

news.text: Magomed Zaynukov, reported as his Doha opponent on Sept. 26, said he had not signed and needs surgery, and would not fight again in 2026.
Wikipedia lists the bout as Sousa vs. TBD and says it is unclear whether a replacement will be found; UFC.com does not list Sousa on the card. No replacement has been named.
Beat Richie Miranda by unanimous decision (29-28 x3) after losing R1 on the mat.
Earned a Performance of the Night bonus for his R3 KO of Bolaji Oki on debut.
